claims.text: Put \(A_m=H^\star(GL_{4m}/B,\mathbb Z)\), \(v_m=v_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}\), and \(w_m=w_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}\). Define \[ \mu_{A_m}(L)=\min\{|G|:G\subseteq L\text{ homogeneous and }L=A_mG\}. \] The parameter conditions hold: \(1\le m+1\le2m\le4m\) and \(m+1>2m+2m-4m=0\). Moreover \[ i=s-t+1=m,\quad j=r-t+1=m,\quad a=b=m. \] In the *same* graded ring \(A_m\), \[ J_{v_m}=\mathbb Z\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v_m\} =\mathbb Z\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\not\le w_m\}=I_{w_m}. \] Hence a homogeneous set generates \(J_{v_m}\) iff it generates \(I_{w_m}\), and therefore \[ \mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m})=\mu_{A_m}(I_{w_m}). \] Thus the source-30 reduction preserves generator number when both ideals are considered in \(A_m\).
No supplied accepted internal result states the required numerical theorem \[ \mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m})=\binom{2m}{m}\qquad(m\ge1). \] The supplied source instead labels this count conjectural.
